en.headline: Primary teacher jailed 36 months for abusing pupils in tutoring
en.dek: A 31-year-old maths teacher admitted eight charges including indecent assault of two boys and making child sexual abuse images, a District Court judge said on Friday.
body: A 31-year-old primary school mathematics teacher was jailed for 36 months on Friday after admitting eight charges arising from unpaid tutoring he advertised online.

Deputy District Judge Ko Wai-hung, sitting at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts in place of the District Court, said the defendant, identified in court by his initials, had abused a position of trust over more than two years. The charges covered indecent assault of a boy who was nine when the offending began, a further offence involving a six-year-old boy, and making and possessing child sexual abuse images. The court heard the lessons took place in a unit at Yuen Long Plaza.

The judge said a psychological report described a high risk of reoffending and treated the possession of images involving children under 10 as an aggravating factor. The victims were not named. The defendant had pleaded guilty earlier.

zh.headline: 小學男教師義教期間非禮男童 認八罪判囚36個月
zh.dek: 31歲數學教師周五在區域法院承認八項罪名，暫委法官指他違反誠信、案情持續超過兩年，判監禁三年。
body: 一名31歲小學數學教師周五承認八項罪名，被判監禁36個月。案情指他在社交網站發文，聲稱免費為基層學生補習數學。
暫委法官高偉雄在西九龍裁判法院暫代區域法院判刑，指被告以英文縮寫應訊，補習期間對兩名男童犯案，其中一名男童開案時九歲，另一名六歲，並涉及製作及管有兒童色情物品。法庭聽取案情指課堂在元朗廣場一個單位進行。
法官指被告違反誠信，對其中一名男童的侵犯持續超過兩年，心理報告顯示重犯機會高，而藏有涉及十歲以下兒童的物品屬加刑因素。兩名事主身份沒有公開。被告早前已認罪。
